about: YOUR REVIEW IN FIVE (5 Nov 2026, Michael): a student feels he knows the task when he holds its shape in his head: one introduction, three body phrases, one recommendation. One core phrase per slot; two more ways to say it unlock once he owns the slot (recalled on two different days); any slot may be his own sentence if it does the slot's job. {X} = the name he types, {a} = a/an + the kind of thing, {plural} = the kind, plural. 'hide' = the word shown as its first letter. v3 (5 Nov): each slot climbs a ladder of five steps, one a day at most: 1 Select (which one does this job?), 2 Match halves, 3 Sort the pieces, 4 Gap-fill (three words, first letters given), 5 From memory (only the job shown). Top of the ladder = the slot is his. 'q' = the Select question; 'picks' = one-tap names.
